newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas rises, 225 lots done, trades in 5 month.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas rises, 225 lots done, trades in 5 month.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures kicked into life on Thursday afternoon with 225 lots traded in eight separate trades spread across five different months, all at higher prices.
This is the largest volume of trade done since 250 lots were traded on June 13.

"There does seem to be another push from the industry," said one futures broker, delighted by the increase in trade. He added that he had been actively looking to trade January, although in the end this was not successful.

Front month August traded at 9.30 pence a therm, up by 0.02 pence a therm from the previous settlement level. But climbs were larger further forward. November and April both rose by a quarter of a penny a therm, trading at 13 pence and 11.85 pence respectively.

"It has been trending lower recently," said a futures broker. He added that trade volumes had been very disappointing in the last few days and that he hoped Thursday's resurgence and the "push" may lead to higher volumes getting done on a more sustained basis.
